identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase III Clinical Study of Cabergoline Tablets Compared With Bromocriptine Mesylate Tablets
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-blind, Double-dummy, Positive Controlled, Multicenter Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Cabergoline Tablets Compared With Bromocriptine Mesylate Tablets in Female Patients With Hyperprolactinemia

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A Phase III clinical study evaluating the efficacy and safety of cabergoline tablets versus bromocriptine mesylate tablets in patients with hyperprolactinemia
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: A randomized, double-blind, double-dummy, active controlled, multicenter Phase III clinical study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Cabergoline tablets compared with Bromocriptine mesylate tablets in female patients with hyperprolactinemia

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: Cabergoline tablets compared with Bromocriptine mesylate tablets

interventions.name: Cabergoline tablets
interventions.description: Cabergoline tablets will be administered for 14 weeks.The allowed dose range is from 0.25 mg (1 tablet) QW to 1mg (4 tablets) QW. Dosage adjustments are made based on the serum PRL level.

interventions.name: Bromocriptine mesylate tablets
interventions.description: Bromocriptine mesylate tablets was administered for 14 weeks.The dose is 1.25 mg (0.5 tablet) QD to 7.5mg 3 tablets) QD. Dosage adjustments are made based on the serum PRL level.

primaryOutcomes.measure: The percentage of subjects whose serum PRL levels returned to normal

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The percentage of subjects whose ovulatory cycles resumed
The percentage of subjects whose galactorrhea disappeared
The percentage of subjects with pituitary PRL tumor shrinkage

locations.facility: Peking Union Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences
